project_type: Flutter mobile app - Influencer Marketing Platform (Rexo)
build_system: Flutter 3.19.0 with pubspec.yaml - CI runs flutter pub get, flutter analyze, flutter build apk
verification_instructions: 1. Run flutter analyze to check for Dart errors. 2. CI runs flutter build apk with --dart-define secrets. 3. analyze has continue-on-error but build must succeed.
setup_instructions: flutter pub get (handled by CI). No local setup possible due to network constraints.
environment_constraints: NETWORK BLOCKED - Cannot install packages via network (403). Must create all files manually. CI handles pub get. No flutter commands available locally. All validation must be done via static code analysis/reading.
contribution_requirements: Push to origin Rexo-Kotlin branch. Build must pass CI (flutter analyze + flutter build apk).
key_patterns: Riverpod StateNotifier for state management, GoRouter for navigation with StatefulShellRoute for bottom nav, Google Fonts Poppins throughout, Iconsax icons, AppColors with primary=#FF5722 (orange-red), premium card widgets, shimmer loading states, SupabaseService static class for DB access, FutureProvider for async data loading, feature-based folder structure (features/<name>/providers|screens|widgets)
directory_structure: lib/ - main source: core/ (router, theme, constants, widgets), features/ (auth, campaigns, home, messages, notifications, profile, shop, wallet), services/ (supabase_service.dart). supabase/ - schema.sql. assets/ - images/, icons/, logo.png. android/, ios/, web/ - platform dirs.
